主要内容: Xnergy Financial LLC, a FINRA/SIPC member, provided investment banking acquisition services to Solar Alliance of America, a leading solar installation provider in San Diego, leading to its acquisition by Finavera Wind Energy Inc. (TSX-V:FVR) on June 25, 2015. The acquisition was completed through a combination of cash and stock. Xnergy Financial was engaged as Solar Alliance's exclusive investment bank to facilitate the sale. Nia Stefani, managing partner of Xnergy Financial, highlighted the firm's focus on emerging growth energy companies and its expertise in renewable energy financing. Xnergy Financial offers services including capital access, merger and acquisition support, financial proposal structuring, and public and private offerings. The firm serves both public and private companies seeking capital for growth, acquisitions, and shareholder liquidity. Xnergy Financial LLC, based in Los Angeles and New York, is focused on emerging growth and middle market companies, providing corporate finance, valuations, and M&A services across various industries.
